item.moviehubtv.remote.tip1: Aim at a TV screen to show the cursor
item.moviehubtv.remote.tip3: Scroll wheel: guide, or volume while watching (sneak + scroll: volume)
block.moviehubtv.speaker: Speaker
block.moviehubtv.speaker.linked: Speaker linked to the TV at %s, %s, %s
block.moviehubtv.speaker.tuned: Speakers tuned to the TV at %s, %s, %s. Place them within %s blocks of it
block.moviehubtv.speaker.tuned_gone: That TV is gone or more than %s blocks away, so this speaker isn't playing anything
block.moviehubtv.speaker.untuned: This speaker isn't tuned to a TV. Break it, right-click a TV while holding it, then place it again
